610:t_2:143.en:
$$トライア$$
「Yes... Thanks to the $$Ｚクリスタル$$, I can understand $$エスター$$'s condition better than before.」

610:t_2:144.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...All right. I trust you, Chief.」

610:t_2:145.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'll live up to that trust. I promise.」

610:t_2:148.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(It is only because she is $$エスター$$... and because she controls events only on the $$ソーラリアン$$'s scale... that she can still retain human form...)

610:t_2:149.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(If you ever use the power of the twelve $$スフィア$$s again... the power of a god... then...)

610:t_2:151.en:
$n
(But if the time comes when I have to... I...)

610:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...It seems quite a lot happened while I was away.」

610:t_10:4.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「It did. But I believe all of it had meaning.」

610:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I sensed it even from afar: you fought with your life on the line, $$マリーダ$$.」

610:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$Ｚチップ$$s it generated total a whopping 1,500 Z! I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

610:t_10:7.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「That's quite a large amount...」

610:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not that this is a reward for that, but please have some ice cream.」

610:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's from a popular shop in $$インダストリアル７$$ that $$バナージ$$ recommended.」

610:t_10:11.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「...Since you've gone to the trouble, I'll have some.」

610:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(You have earned your rest, $$マリーダ$$... Allow me to celebrate you for overturning fate.)

610:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Your vivid way of living touched many people.)

610:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(It generated 1,000 Z in $$Ｚチップ$$s... I will add them to the unit's stock.)

610:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(And we swear to your soul that we will overturn fate...)

610:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've returned after quite some time, but this place really does put me most at ease...」

610:t_10:23.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「So this is the famous $$Ｄトレーダー$$.」

610:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... The only other person for whom 'Lady' fits quite so perfectly must be Lady $$ハマーン$$.」

610:t_10:26.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Enough with the silly flattery. I'm no longer $$クロノ$$'s Queen. I'm a member of $c now.」

610:t_10:28.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「I know. I know the rules here too.」

610:t_10:29.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「It's best to get unpleasant things over with quickly. Let's do it.」

610:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's give it our all today too!」

610:t_10:34.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Oh, stop... It's embarrassing, so don't keep bringing it up...」

610:t_10:35.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「What on earth is the point of making people say something like that...?」

610:t_10:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Such earnestness and innocence beneath that haughty mask... I simply can't resist...」

610:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Now then, starting today, I will join the front line too. I've prepared 2,000 Z in $$Ｚチップ$$s as a starting fund.」

610:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you haven't upgraded your $$Ｚクリスタル$$ yet, please use these to help the $$ソーラリアン$$ control events.」

611:t_000:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「A joint operation by the $$新地球皇国$$'s three armies is truly a magnificent sight.」

611:t_000:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Now we just need to add victory, and it will be perfect.」

611:t_000:2.en:
$$尸刻$$
「There is no need to worry. We have prepared a plan that guarantees victory.」

611:t_000:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Guaranteed victory... is it?」

611:t_000:4.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「If there's a problem with that, call it total victory, overwhelming victory, glorious victory, or decisive victory.」

611:t_000:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It seems the $$ハイアデス$$ dictionary contains only the word 'victory'.」

611:t_000:6.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「This is an enemy we cannot defeat unless we steel ourselves like that.」

611:t_000:8.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Forget I said that, Miss $$尸刻$$. I, $$ダバラーン・タウ$$... seek only victory.」

611:t_000:9.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Understood. I too, $$尸刻$$... promise to contribute to your victory, General.」

611:t_000:10.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Allow me to thank you. And I pledge victory to you.」

611:t_000:11.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...Are you sure about that, General $$ダバラーン$$? I'll tell $$エルーナルーナ$$ and $$尸空#pilot$$ on you.」

611:t_000:12.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Even $$尸空#pilot$$ might get angry if a man tries cozying up to his little sister.」

611:t_000:14.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Yes... $$尸空#pilot$$ is my older brother.」

611:t_000:16.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Haha... It seems you didn't know.」

611:t_000:17.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Then, now that we've relaxed a little, let us welcome $c.」

611:t_001:0.en:
$$渓$$
「Look! The aides from all three units are here!」

611:t_001:1.en:
$$凱$$
「So they're combining their three forces into one?!」

611:t_001:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Exactly! Can you break through this ironclad formation, $c?!」

611:t_001:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「Whatever you say, we're coming through, $$サイデリアル$$!」

611:t_001:4.en:
$$葵$$
「Learning the truth has made us many times angrier at you!」

611:t_001:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Earth's counteroffensives have begun almost simultaneously across the world.」

611:t_001:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「To succeed in storming $$ラース・バビロン$$, we must capture this $$セントラル・ベース$$, the heart of the Central Asian front.」

611:t_001:7.en:
$$レド$$
「Once we break through here, it's a straight shot to the Emperor!」

611:t_001:8.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「If the Reactors are waiting in the imperial capital, we'll defeat their aides here!」

611:t_001:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's been a while since I felt this... It feels like I've come home.」

611:t_001:11.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Ah... um... well... what I said before... I just... got a little carried away... You know... um...」

611:t_001:12.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You see! It was such a dramatic reunion, and I got swept up in the mood!」

611:t_001:13.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So, um... don't dwell on it too much...」

611:t_001:15.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Stop. Let's leave the rest until the fighting is over.」

611:t_001:16.en:
$n
「You mean after we capture the $$セントラル・ベース$$?」

611:t_001:18.en:
$n
「Do you mean after we defeat Emperor $$アウストラリス$$ in $$ラース・バビロン$$?」

611:t_001:19.en:
$$スズネ$$
「No. I mean after both the $$蒼の地球$$ and the $$翠の地球$$ are completely at peace.」
